blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A father and his son were shot dead on Saturday, Oct. 24, allegedly over a long-standing land dispute in Catanauan, Quezon. In a report on Sunday, Calabarzon police said the suspect confronted the 37-year-old victim over an old grudge stemming from a land dispute involving the victim’s father. The confrontation occurred at 5:10 p.m. while the two men were watching a billiards game in Barangay San Pablo Suha.
